name: Home Assistant
summary: Home Assistant is an open-source home automation platform that runs locally and connects thousands of smart-home devices. Its built-in MCP server lets agents such as Claude or ChatGPT read home state and control exposed devices, and it can also call external MCP servers from its own Assist agents.
facts: OAuth 2.0 with PKCE; admin-only by default
Uses external MCP tools in Assist (tools only)
Self-hosted; remote agents need internet reachability
goodFor: Letting an agent control lights, climate and media
Reading home sensor state as context
Local-first smart home with no vendor lock-in
watchOut: Cloud agents need your instance exposed to the internet
Exposes all LLM APIs by default; scope it down
MCP server lacks sampling and notifications
